t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Bad Hair Day
d: A pet groomer gets rave reviews but needs Cesar's help with handling some difficult clients. A Chihuahua makes a lot of noise, causing chaos with her cohabiters. Can Cesar install calm in the pack?

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Nuna & Kane
d: NuNu the Chihuahua, fiercely attacks anyone who comes near his owner Tina. NuNu’s total opposite, Kane the Great Dane, is vehemently afraid of shiny surfaces

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Opie & Flirt
d: Black lab mix Opie is a charmer around people, but frighteningly aggressive around other dogs. Energetic to the point of being neurotic, Chinese Crested Flirt cannot sit still for one moment.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Rana & Ruby
d: Scared of everything, Ruby the Vischla deals with her neuroses by biting.  At the same time, Rana barks every time bread pops in the toaster, or when the microwave goes off, or when the phone rings.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Josh & Boomer
d: Josh, a Maltese, will not let anyone with a brush or pair of scissors near him without putting up a fight.  Boomer, a Chesapeake Bay Retriever, barks incessantly and refuses to come out of the pool.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Harry & Brooks
d: Harry wants to charge after anything with wheels, including passing cyclists, rollerbladers or skateboarders. Brooks, an Entlebucher, is constantly chasing after light, he is never calm.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Coach & Sueki
d: Coach, an out of control Boxer, bit a neighbor, seemingly sealing his fate.  Coach gets a stay of execution when Cesar Millan comes to the rescue.  Sueki refuses to walk on the leash.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Slick & Pepper
d: Slick, a rare white Puli, is full of phobias. When clients come to Christopher’s photography studio, they are greeted by Pepper’s annoying barking and heel nipping.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Ava & Gus
d: Ava, a Pug/Pekingese swiftly twirls for all occasions, possibly a neurological condition Cesar cannot treat. Gus the Bouvier greets people by throwing his 100 pound body at them.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Maya & Churchill
d: Churchill the Rottweiler is a well mannered dog, except when around other animals. Meanwhile, Maya, an affable Pit Bull, insists on being intimately involved in all operations of the household.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Bubba & Garrett
d: Heidi Wasserman inherited Bubba, a spoiled Maltese that demands to be taken everywhere and nips at anyone who tries to leave. Garrett, a German Shepherd, chases his tail, obsessively.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Emily
d: Emily, a Pit Bull, has become every owner’s worst nightmare – extremely aggressive towards other dogs.  She’s so out of control, only Cesar Millan’s 6-week boot camp can turn her behavior around.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Hank & Paris
d: Marsha Alexander’s rescued Mastiff has ruined the furniture and intimidates anyone walking by his gate. Paris, a long hair Chihuahua, looks fashionable, but barks and snaps at strangers.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Sasha & Shep
d: Lhasa Apso Sasha, bares her teeth at anyone who takes anything from her.  White German Shepherd, “Shep,” goes after strangers, making it impossible for his wheelchair bound owner to control.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Jake & King
d: Jake tends to mind his owner Bob but goes crazy to protect Bob’s wife Linda. At the same time, all of 10 year old Chantel’s might is hardly enough for 150 pound King to even take notice.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Scrawny & Lola
d: Scrawny, one of nine Yorkies, is Allen’s favorite, but attacks anyone that comes near. Lola, a Dalmatian, barks at everything. Find out how Cesar reestablishes control in both homes.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: J & Alice
d: J is unpredictable and aggressive and his owner is now dealing with a lawsuit. Alice is depressed and aggressive towards the other two dogs in the house – a potentially lethal combination.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Caper & Julius
d: Caper has a lot of energy, particularly when it comes to chasing down balls non-stop. Julius is a four-year-old Pit Bull mix that is frightened of everything.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Bella & Jordan
d: “Bella Angel” is a devil in disguise. She bites anyone who comes near the house or the family.  Jordan, an English Bulldog, jumps up and down, licks people incessantly and is obsessed by skateboards.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Sunshine & Teddy
d: Sunshine is a champion Doberman in the show ring but far too aggressive in the street.  Teddy, a yellow lab, has bitten its owner twice, and has attacked more than one stranger.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Goldie & Pepsi
d: Pepsi, a German Shepherd, becomes intensely aggressive around cats.  Goldie, the beautiful Brittany Spaniel of “General Hospital” star Jacklyn Zeman that has become aggressive towards female dogs.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Nicki
d: Nicky, a 4-year old black Rottweiler, suffered terribly in his youth. His new owner has given him a loving home. However, there are a few old habits he can’t shake, including dog aggression.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Percy & Justice
d: Percy, a West Highland White Terrier, is a handful, biting anyone who tries to touch his hindquarters. Justice, a Pit Bull, is slowly escalating toward dangerous aggression.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Stewart & Buddy
d: Stewart, a Chow/Golden Retriever mix, barks and growls at and seems to be fearful and aggressive toward children. Every time Johnny turns on the hose, Buddy the Beagle runs for the house.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Lucy & Lizzie
d: Lucy the Dalmatian snarls at larger dogs then turns in circles and attacks her own tail. Lizzie, a Red Tick Elizabethan Beagle, is obsessed with running, inside or outside.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Sophie & Daisy
d: Sophie, a Sheltie-Golden nix, tries to nip at the heels of her owner’s horse. Daisy has an annoying problem – she tries to “hump” various members of the Benda family.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Boyfriend & Alfie
d: “Boyfriend” is a Shephard mix that has repeatedly bitten his owner’s boyfriend. Alfie is the aggressive English Bulldog of popular actress/television host Daisy Fuentes.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Brady, Bandit, and Hootie
d: Water-obsessed Labrador; a pooch with performance anxiety; a leg chomping Chihuahua.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Sonny, Cinnamon & Chocolate, and Boo
d: Pug and pet pig get rowdy; emotionally scarred Shepherd; two Dachshunds make an unsavory mix.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Buddy, Teddy, and Matilda
d: Lab/Staffordshire mix unfriendly to small animals; a poodle that can't stop running in circles; bulldog obsessed with attaching skateboard wheels.

t: Mannen som talar med hundar: Jonbee, Hudson & Violet, and Buford
d: A ferocious stray Jindo in desperate need of rescue, a Great Dane wreaks havoc on house and home, a boxer mourns the death of a beloved mate.
